title: Harness path-deny domain registry
description: SEAL-01 shape contract for the DECLARATION of the harness's path-deny domains. Constrains SHAPE ONLY, and the instance it validates ENFORCES NOTHING: the hooks named by each record's owner_module/owner_constant remain the single source of truth, and no hook imports the instance (a registry the hooks read would make the phase-30 drift test a tautology). Two semantic rules are NOT expressible here — uniqueness of 'id' ACROSS records and uniqueness of 'owner_constant' ACROSS records, since uniqueItems compares whole objects rather than one field — and are enforced by tools.deny_domains.registry, mirroring the equivalent note in contracts/harness/docs/doc-dependencies.schema.json. Self-contained Draft 2020-12 — no cross-file $ref.

version.description: Registry format version. A shape change is a constitution-plane act, so this is a const rather than a free string.

domains.description: One record per ENFORCING path-deny domain. A domain that enumerates no paths (e.g. tools/hooks/commit_gate.py) is deliberately absent — see the instance's _note.

non_enforcing_glob_sets.description: Glob lists that resemble a deny domain but gate no tool call. Declared so a reader cannot mistake a same-named constant in a non-hook module for a deny domain.

_note.description: Prose the instance carries about its own standing: what it declares, what it does not enforce, and what is deliberately absent.

domain_id.description: A CLOSED enum, deliberately. Adding a fourth path-deny domain is an architectural act requiring a superseding ADR and a schema change on the constitution plane — never a data edit adding a registry row. The three members are separate by decision (docs/adr/0010-human-docs-review-obligation-model.md clause 3b): the constitution domain honours a human token, the review-ledger domain honours none and must never teach an operator to reach for one, and the secret domain is provably disjoint from both.

bypass_token.description: An environment token whose non-empty, non-blank value lets a write through the domain's gate.

tool_surface.description: A runtime tool surface, spelled in the Claude matcher vocabulary; the opencode adapters use the lower-cased spellings.

runtime.description: One of the two emitted runtimes.

owner_module.description: Dotted module path of the domain's single authoritative home, resolvable by importlib.

owner_constant.description: Name of the glob constant inside owner_module. Uniqueness ACROSS records is not expressible in JSON Schema; tools.deny_domains.registry enforces it, and that is what structurally forbids merging two domains into one record.

globs.description: The glob list RESTATED from owner_module.owner_constant, in source order. Restated, never imported: the drift test that compares this list against the live constant would be a tautology if the hook read it from here.

bypasses.description: Tokens that let a write through this domain's gate. minItems is deliberately NOT set: the EMPTY ARRAY is the meaningful value for the domains that honour no opt-out, and the key is REQUIRED so 'no bypass' is an assertion rather than an absence a reader must infer from an omitted key.

covered_tool_surfaces.description: Tool surfaces on which this domain's gate actually runs, per the emitted runtime wiring.

uncovered_tool_surfaces.description: The SEAL-01 field: tool surfaces this domain does NOT gate, recorded as DATA rather than prose so the gap is readable by a machine. It is NOT the complement of covered_tool_surfaces — a surface the domain has no business gating is not listed. Shrinking this set is a later phase's work, not this contract's.

content_axis.description: Optional: a deny axis this domain applies that is NOT path-based.

surfaces.description: The surface spellings AS THE ADAPTER WRITES THEM — Claude matcher alternatives, opencode lower-cased tool names — not normalized, so a drift check compares like with like.

runtime_adapters.description: Where each runtime wires the gate. The emitted trees are derived; the authored source for the Claude side is tools/harness_emit/merge.py.

enforcement_sites.description: Optional: enforcement layers BEYOND the PreToolUse hook, in the ADR-0010 clause 3b sense — each covering a surface the others structurally cannot.

declared_by.description: Repo-relative path of the accepted decision record — or, where no decision record names the domain, the authored data source — that declares this domain's membership. The named artifact decides; this registry restates.

reason.description: Why this glob set is NOT a deny domain — what it is actually for, and what would go wrong if it were read as one.
